styles.name: Minimal / Clean
styles.palette: one neutral ground, one accent, at most two ink colours
styles.type: one restrained sans family, few sizes, generous tracking
styles.imagery: single hero object or photo with lots of breathing room
styles.composition: one focal point, wide margins, strong negative space

styles.name: Swiss / International
styles.palette: 2-3 flat colours, one strong accent, white or off-white ground
styles.type: large grotesk headline, asymmetric alignment, tight hierarchy
styles.imagery: photography cropped hard to the grid, or none
styles.composition: visible modular grid, strong left alignment
styles.failure_mode: A grid with no idea behind it

styles.name: Editorial / Magazine
styles.palette: muted neutrals, one deep ink, one warm accent
styles.type: refined serif display with a clean sans for supporting text
styles.imagery: photo-led, full-bleed or generous crop, natural texture
styles.texture: subtle paper grain, uncoated stock feel
styles.lighting: soft directional daylight, long gentle shadows
styles.composition: magazine grid, generous margins, cover-line hierarchy

styles.name: Luxury / Premium
styles.palette: dark or warm neutral ground, one metallic accent used sparingly
styles.type: thin elegant serif display, wide letterspacing, small supporting sans
styles.imagery: single premium object, macro detail, deep negative space
styles.texture: matte paper, brushed metal, soft sheen
styles.lighting: low-key controlled light, single specular highlight
styles.composition: centred or asymmetric restraint, slow reading pace

styles.name: Bold Typographic
styles.palette: 2-3 high-contrast colours, one dominant ground
styles.type: huge condensed sans, tight leading, headline as the image
styles.imagery: none or one small supporting crop
styles.composition: type fills the frame, strong diagonal or stacked blocks

styles.name: Bauhaus / Geometric
styles.palette: primary red, blue, yellow plus black and off-white
styles.type: geometric sans, circular or constructed letterforms
styles.imagery: flat geometric shapes, circles, squares, triangles
styles.composition: constructivist balance, diagonal axes, strong asymmetry

styles.name: Brutalist
styles.palette: black, white, one raw accent; high contrast
styles.type: oversized grotesk, raw spacing, intentional awkwardness
styles.imagery: lo-fi photo, scan, or none
styles.lighting: harsh flash or flat scan light
styles.composition: raw grid, exposed structure, broken alignment

styles.name: Neo-brutalism
styles.palette: flat bright fills, black outlines, one hot accent
styles.type: chunky sans, thick strokes, hard offset shadows
styles.imagery: simple flat icons or cut-out objects
styles.lighting: no realistic light, hard graphic shadow
styles.composition: stacked cards, thick borders, offset blocks

styles.name: Memphis / 80s
styles.palette: clashing pastels and brights with black and white anchors
styles.type: bold geometric or playful display sans
styles.imagery: squiggles, confetti, abstract shapes, simple objects
styles.composition: controlled chaos, scattered shapes, asymmetric clusters

styles.name: Retro / Vintage (70s, mid-century)
styles.palette: warm muted browns, oranges, cream, faded teal
styles.type: rounded 70s display, wide spacing, chunky serif or sans
styles.imagery: sunbursts, stripes, lifestyle photo with warm cast
styles.composition: centred badge or retro poster stack

styles.name: Risograph / Print texture
styles.palette: two or three spot colours, duotone overlaps
styles.type: bold sans or quirky display, limited sizes
styles.imagery: halftone photo, simple illustration
styles.composition: poster grid, bold blocks, imperfect alignment
styles.failure_mode: Texture as a cover for weak layout

styles.name: Collage / Mixed media
styles.palette: mixed source colours unified by one tint or paper ground
styles.type: cut-out display, mixed weights, ransom-note energy
styles.imagery: torn paper, cut-out photos, layered ephemera
styles.composition: layered montage, diagonal movement, controlled overlap

styles.name: Organic / Natural
styles.palette: earthy greens, clay, sand, cream, muted terracotta
styles.type: soft serif or humanist sans, rounded terminals
styles.imagery: botanicals, handmade objects, natural textures
styles.composition: flowing asymmetry, hand-placed elements, generous space

styles.name: Hand-drawn / Illustrative
styles.palette: limited ink palette with one warm accent
styles.type: hand-lettered display, friendly sans body
styles.imagery: line art, doodles, sketched objects, marginalia
styles.composition: loose hand-placed layout, uneven baselines

styles.name: Flat Illustration
styles.palette: limited flat palette, one accent, no gradients
styles.type: clean geometric sans, strong hierarchy
styles.imagery: vector scenes, simple shapes, stylised people
styles.composition: modular scene, clear focal action, generous spacing

styles.name: Soft 3D / Clay
styles.palette: pastel grounds, soft complementary accents
styles.type: rounded sans, friendly weight, simple hierarchy
styles.imagery: rounded 3D objects, clay or inflatable materials
styles.texture: matte clay, soft plastic, subtle grain
styles.lighting: soft studio HDRI, gentle contact shadows
styles.composition: floating objects, centred or isometric arrangement

styles.name: Photographic / Lifestyle
styles.palette: true-to-life colour, one grade, minimal overlays
styles.type: restrained sans or classic serif, small and confident
styles.imagery: real photography, natural light, lived-in environments
styles.texture: subtle film grain, no heavy filters
styles.lighting: natural window light or golden hour
styles.composition: photo-led, generous crop, text in quiet areas

styles.name: Gradient / Aurora
styles.palette: two or three luminous colours in a controlled mesh or linear blend
styles.type: modern geometric sans, clean hierarchy
styles.imagery: abstract glow fields, soft 3D forms, or none
styles.composition: centred hero, expansive gradient ground
styles.failure_mode: The #1 AI-slop palette, so use with care

styles.name: Dark / Neon
styles.palette: near-black ground, one or two neon accents
styles.type: condensed sans or techno display, tight tracking
styles.imagery: night photography, neon signage, reflective surfaces
styles.texture: wet gloss, chromatic aberration, subtle scanlines
styles.lighting: hard neon rim light, deep shadows
styles.composition: centred hero or diagonal energy, dark negative space

styles.name: Pop Art / Comic
styles.palette: primary colours, black outlines, white ground
styles.type: bold comic display, heavy outlines, speech-bubble energy
styles.imagery: halftone portraits, comic panels, product hero
styles.lighting: flat comic light with hard shadow
styles.composition: panel grid or burst, strong focal face/object

styles.name: Art Deco
styles.palette: black, deep green or navy, gold or champagne accent
styles.type: tall elegant display, geometric ornament, wide letterspacing
styles.imagery: symmetrical ornament, fan motifs, premium objects
styles.composition: strict symmetry, stepped frames, vertical emphasis
